subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open cross-repo fix candidate for this focused prune cleanup, or fold the cleanup into the broader managed sandbox lifecycle work?
rationale: The source-level bug remains clear, but a conflicting open PR already closes this issue and the related lifecycle issue raises ownership and state-deletion boundaries that should be decided by a maintainer before automation opens another fix path.

options.title: Review or replace the narrow cleanup
options.body: Adopt the useful idea from the linked candidate or open a replacement that deletes only eligible non-shared workspaces after successful runtime removal and adds focused regression tests.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open as supporting evidence while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98516 defines the permanent session-owned sandbox cleanup contract.

options.title: Close the stale candidate first
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting cross-repo PR before queueing any new repair so there is one canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the narrow cleanup
recommendation.body: Adopt the useful idea from the linked candidate or open a replacement that deletes only eligible non-shared workspaces after successful runtime removal and adds focused regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and refactored the central sandbox lifecycle paths and authored the broader related lifecycle issue.
